motive.zhHans: 但 Chiba 解释说他被拦下了，因为他可能会引发事故，尤其是在他慌张驾车的情况下。Aono 漏听了那条语音留言，因为他一直忙着打她的电话，也因为他过于悲痛而没有注意到，意识到自己杀害了两名无辜女性后，他崩溃痛哭。
motive.en: But Chiba explains that he was held back, because he could have caused an accident, especially if he drove his car in a panic. Aono missed the voicemail, because he had been busy trying to call her phone and because he was too distressed to notice, realizing that he murdered two innocent women he breaks down crying.

method.zhHans: 事故地点：未知 被害人：Naeko Miike 年龄：24 岁 伤势：弩箭伤 犯人：Kengo Aono 犯人先前设置的弩箭射来时，Naeko 为 Chiba 挡下了那一箭，因此受伤。在 Naeko 用了 Chiba 当年对她说过的话——不要闯红灯、要遵守交通法规——之后，Chiba 终于认出 Naeko 是自己的青梅竹马。
method.en: Accident Location: Unknown Victim: Naeko Miike Age: 24 years old Injury: Crossbow shot wound Culprit: Kengo Aono Naeko saved Chiba from a crossbow arrow that the culprit had rigged earlier resulting in her injury. Chiba finally recognises Naeko as his childhood friend after the latter used the same words that Chiba said to her about not crossing the red light and respecting traffic laws.

evidence.zhHans: 这证明了在任何情况下他都不可能拦住她。
evidence.en: It proves that he could never have stopped her in any circumstances.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Kengo Aono。地点：大厅内 被害人：Naeko Miike
resolution.en: The culprit is Kengo Aono. Location: Inside Hall Victim: Naeko Miike
